newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBs seen staying at higher end of 126.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBs seen staying at higher end of 126.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK FOR BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: No operation expected
*Key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract likely to stay within recent range at higher end of 126 ahead of new 10-year JGB auction expected on Tuesday.
*Bank of Japan to hold two-day branch managers' meeting from Monday, also keeping December contract from moving widely.
